batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b R Tewatia

batting.dismissal: c GJ Bailey b L Balaji

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: st WP Saha b Karanveer Singh

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b Karanveer Singh

batting.name: R Tewatia
batting.dismissal: c Karanveer Singh b AR Patel

balls.text: this was a low full toss down the leg side but Bailey moved a long way across the stumps to swing, he missed and the keeper has some work to do to collect that, the umpire signals a bye but Bailey was a bit perplexed and was expecting a wide, he has a discussion with the two umpires and their decision is final. Nothing heated, just an enqiry
swings and misses a slower ball, they pick up another bye
swings it to the leg side and it's in the air, the fielder does well at deep square leg to run to his left and take it on the first bounce
that's a bonus for Kings XI, fine leg was up, it was down the leg side, Miller had a swing and the inside edge took it past short fine leg
this was full outside off and he drills it down the ground to long-off
good slower ball to start with, Miller made a lot of room and swung and missed, they steal a bye
this was short of a length and pulled, miscued and just clears square leg
sends this over deep midwicket, length ball on the stumps and he makes room and slogs him away
he is caught off the Free Hit at third man, makes room and gets an outside edge that carries all the way to Tambe
Faulker has overstepped, he makes room again and chips it down to deep point
gets away with a full toss, wide outside the off stump, he makes room and chips it to deep point
that was high and far, the slower ball from Faulkner, angling down leg and Bailey made room and lofted it over wide long-on, several rows back
exploits the fact there's nobody at deep cover, length ball and he makes room and carves it over cover, there are plenty patroling the leg side though
breaks the boundary drought! This was tossed up and Miller was down the track and lofted it dead straight and cleared the sight screen, in fact Tambe bowled that from behind the crease
down the track and drives off the toe of the bat to deep cover
he comes down the track and drills it hard down to long-off
forced it down to deep midwicket for a couple

Miller is in trouble and Royals are confident they have run him out! Miller works it towards long-on and challenges Rahane's throw by going for the second run, he dives and replays show that he has just made it before Samson breaks the bails
comes down the track and works it towards deep square leg and only a single
makes room and the bowler follows him by bowling on the body, pulls but can't beat short fine leg
makes room to a length ball and pushes it hard down to long-off
slower ball and forced Bailey into checking his shot, stabbed it down to cover
this was a fuller ball and he works it away down to deep midwicket
full on the stumps and he drills it down to long-off
this was a length ball on the pads and he tucks it towards long-on and does well to push for the second
he uses his feet and comes down the track and works it to the leg side
flatter delivery and he drills it down towards long-on
he makes a bit of room and chops it to the off side
down the track and driven down to cover
he drops it a bit short and he makes room and cuts
full on the pads and he drives it to long-on
tossed up and he comes down the track and the ball hits his pads and rolls away
tossed up a but more and he drives on the up to long-on
well judged by Rahane in the deep, tossed up and Saha gives the charge and looks to clear long-on, he hits it flat and Rahane jogs to his left and takes it
this was tossed up slower  and he drives it to the off side
this was tossed up and full and he drills it down to long-off
tossed up on the stumps and he drives him to cover
gets forward and across and plays it towards third man
he shuffles and works it behind square on the on side
good length outside off and he punches it to the off side
the placement wasn't bad at all... it was a top edge that dropped short as two fielders converged, it was short and he was looking to hook, Faulkner and Watson ran forward and hard luck for Royals
good length on the stumps and he gets an outside edge towards cover

Marsh perishes going for the big hit, it was a slower ball from Malik round the wicket, Marsh doesn't get the power behind it to take it over the rope, it goes flat to long-on and Rahane jogs to his right and catches it
another poor ball put away, short ball down the leg side, swivels and pulls one bounce to fine leg
that was smashed past backward point, Faulkner makes the mistake by giving him width outside off, bends slightly, gets beside the line and thrashes it
this was a quicker bouncer and he looks to hook and misses
close call for Saha as he pokes at one moving away and nearly edges it
good length outside the off stump and he punches it towards cover
Faulkner round the wicket and he gets forward and across and pushes it towards point
gets forward and pulls him down to fine leg
gives him a lot of width this time and he dabs it down to third man
on the pads and he turns it behind square on the on side for a couple
super placement from Marsh, this was a half volley outside off and moving away, he leans forward and places it wide of sweeper cover
beaten this time, hasn't happened too often, full and moving away and he chases it but misses
this was short of a length outside off and he stays back and dabs it down to third man
this was a bit wide too and he punches it to cover
this was too wide outside off
heads up! Tossed up on the off stump and Marsh took a couple of paces down and slogs him against the spin, it was a googly, sends it a few rows over deep midwicket
he gives him width and cuts him to deep point
gets to the pitch of the ball and he works it to long-on
tossed up and he rocks back and cuts him hard down to point
comes down the track and drills it down the track and the bowler slides and stops it
drops it short and he goes back and pulls to deep midwicket
low full toss on the pads and he misses out, clips the pads and rolls away
close call for Marsh as he looks to cut but is beaten
he goes back and cuts to the off side
that was raw power, tossed up and Marsh was a few paces down the track and lofts dead straight down to the sight screen
drops it short and he goes back and pulls to square leg
comes to the pitch of the ball and drills it to long-on
goes back and cuts to sweeper cover
that was delicately played, he had some width and gently dabbed it well wide of first slip, he picked his spot well
that was well bowled by Tewatia, the googly and Marsh was down the pitch and got an outside edge that dropped short of Watson at slip
tossed up and he pushes it to the off side
flatter and wider outside the off stump and cut down to point
fuller on the stumps and softly pushed towards long-on
shuffles and clips him down to square leg
less power, same result, this was drifting down the leg side and Saha went down and gently paddled it to fine leg
punishes the length, he drops it short and he swivels and pulls firmly wide of square leg
bowls it flatter and he makes room and cuts him to point
fuller ball on the off stump and driven down to long-on
gets forward and drills this down to long-off
works it to the on side
clips it down to long-on to get off the mark

there's an appeal for an lbw and Vohra fails to ground the bat! The ball didn't turn and Vohra clipped it towards midwicket and he was getting back for the second and Binny's throw to the striker's end was accurate, Vohra was very casual in getting back and that's a schoolboy error
drifts in towards the pads and Vohra didn't pick him and the ball clips the pads
he stays back and gets an inside edge to the pads
that's a good slower ball, Marsh didn't read it very well, stabbed it to the off side
good length on the off stump and he defends down the track
he drifts on the pads with the fine leg up and the ball clips his pads, Samson dives and stops
he was fully in control of this, this was a half volley wide outside off, leans forward and drives wide of cover and doesn't look to push at it too hard, relied on timing
not in control of this one, this was short and he went for the pull but miscued it over square leg
this was short and wide outside off and asking to be hit, Marsh slashes this over backward point, in the air but safe
good length angling across and he punches it to the off side
he gets across his stumps and punches it to the off side
all timing on that one, this was a length ball shaping away and he went forward, shows the full face of the bat and it races to long-off
length ball and he stays back and defends this one
punches it down the ground to long-on
this was a bouncer down the leg side, Vohra looks to hook and nearly gets some bat on it
gets across the line and punches it towards point
he makes a bit of room and punches it towards mid-off
that was quite effortless! We have seen this from Vohra before, this was a length ball on the pads and he plays the pick up shot and chips it a few rows over deep midwicket
a bit too straight on the pads, he uses his wrists well and whips it away towards square leg
good length on the stumps and he shuffles and clips him to midwicket
and he gets off the mark with a dab down to third man
that's a soft dismissal! Sehwag was looking to whip that away down to the leg side, played a bit too early and he ends up getting a tame top edge to mid-on, very easy catch for the fielder
a half volley on the off stump and Sehwag gets a big stride forward and drilled down to long-on
Vohra wafts at a short of a length ball outside off and is beaten by the bounce and movement away from him
Watson gets the ball to lift from a good length and straighten too after pitching around off stump, Vohra prods from his crease and is beaten
banged in short once again, Vohra tries to pull but is beaten
the ball rises from a good length outside off and Vohra is beaten as he tries to chip it towards third man
Samson leaps to his left to collect a wayward ball down leg side
a half-volley outside off stump, Vohra gets down on one knee and drives through cover point, superbly timed
good length and straight from Watson, defended with a straight bat back to the bowler
length delivery outside off, Sehwag gets on the front foot and throws his bat at it, carving the ball over the backward point boundary
short and wide outside off, Sehwag loves it there, he does! He goes after the ball with a hard slash and the ball bounces inches short of the third man boundary
a length ball outside off stump, Sehwag moves forward and lofts the ball on the up and through the line, one-bounce four to wide long off
Sehwag tries to punch on the up through cover but is beaten by the movement away from him
good length just outside off, the ball holds its line and keeps a bit low too, Sehwag stays in his crease and prods but is beaten
banged in short but the line is down leg side
a length ball outside off stump, Sehwag punches from the crease, timing it superbly but not finding the gap at cover
length ball and he pulls this one to deep square leg and Kings XI take pole position in the playoffs, they are the No.1 team
a single to fine leg is all he will get, down the leg side and pulled down to fine leg
he continues to swing them over the ropes, it was a length ball and he sent it over deep midwicket
good yorker and he drills this down to long-off and he refuses the single
when he connects it flies, this was a slower ball and landing on a full length and Faulkner sends that a few rows over wide long-on
nearly dragged that onto his stumps, this was a low full toss, he had the room but he missed it and the ball nearly shaved the off stump
fuller and he drills this down to long-on
another full toss and he gets away with it this time, outside off and thudded down to long-off on the first bounce
Fualkner's not giving up and boy that went really far back! This was a friendly full toss by Balaji, Faulkaner stayed at the crease and launched it several rows over the sight screen
fuller and he drills it hard down to Miller at long-off, Miller's throw hits the stumps at the bowler's and the third umpire takes a look, Malik's bat was in the air for a while but he grounded it
4 + 6! This was a length ball outside off and Faulkner fetched that and launched it over long-on, clean strike
this was a low full toss outside off and Faulkner reached out and hit it hard wide of sweeper cover
turns it to midwicket for a single

fine running catch by Marsh! Tossed up and Cooper looks to smash it over the off side but miscues it, it was high in the air and falling in front of long-off and Marsh had a lot of ground to cover, he timed his fall well and took it and held on after hitting the ground
comes forward and lofts this one down to wide long-off and the fielder does well to cut it off and parry it to sweeper cover
another easy stumping for Saha, Hodge was looking to advance down the track and he made room, Akshar fired this towards the leg stump and Hodge was a long way down and missed it
flatter one and he sweeps and Hendricks fumbles at deep square leg and parries it to deep midwicket
he gets on his knee and sweeps him down to square leg
expensive over! This was a length ball sliding on the pads and he lofts this one over long-on, 22 off this over
the slow bouncer, Hendricks bowls this one from the back of the hand, Hodge was looking to hook but got his head out of the way
length ball outside off and he makes room and carves this one down to third man

Marsh has overrun this! Hendricks comes round the wicket and Hodge lofts a length ball straight down the ground and it goes towards long-on, Marsh ran a couple of yards too many to his left and the ball bounced over his head
he fires this one full and wide outside the off stump and Hodge really has to reach out and he bangs this wide of cover
Hodge welcomes Hendricks to the crease with a huge hit over deep square leg, he bowls this one short and he bludgeons it
he knocks it towards deep midwicket for a couple
Karanveer takes this easily, Tewatia looks to go for another slog but doesn't get the distance and this time he finds the fielder at deep square leg
breaks the boundary drought but is it too late? Tossed up and Tewatia gets on his knee and slogs this over deep midwicket and Vohra nearly catches it but the ball parries over
he stays back and knocks it towards midwicket
flatter one on the pads and he gets on his knee and sweeps to the on side
he makes room and punches it to the off side
this was a slower ball and he makes room to swing and misses
this was a low full toss which he heaves towards the leg side
he strays wide down the leg side
on the pads and tucked away towards fine leg and Karanweer slides and cuts it off
he moved right across his stumps and looked to push it to the on side and it hits the pad and rolls away
the lap shot that didn't come off as well as expected, he moved right across his stumps and nearly lost his balance, just about cleared the keeper
doesn't give him much room, he punches it to the off side
skids through and he tucks it to the on side
Hodge this time looks to cut and he is beaten, Karanveer's winning this round
softly pushed it to the off side
spin, bounce and turn again and Hodge was completely squared up! Fine ball
tossed up and Hodge comes forward and defends
stumped by a mile! And Karanveer impresses, Samson was down the track to launch that and was completely foxed by flight, bounce and turn, nowhere near the pitch of the ball, didn't bother to get back
bowls that flatter and fuller and he drives to cover
comes forward and drives this one down to long-off for a single
drives down to sweeper cover for a single
Samson looking to hit out and he gets an outside edge that rolls to short third man, he's desperate for boundaries
he bowls round the wicket to the left-hander, clips the pads as he looks to sweep
Tewatia goes airborne again this time and it's down to long-off
Tewatia lofts this one towards deep cover and Miller does well this time to run to his left to stop it
dropped it short and he pulled it with force and Dhawan did really well to sprint to his right and cut it off before the rope
he comes down the track and gets an outside edge towards short third man
begins with the sweep down to deep square leg

high catching practice for Shaun Marsh at long-off, tossed up and Binny made room and gave him the charge, wanted to clear long-off but it was a half hearted shot more than anything else, easy for Marsh
good length on the stumps and he pushes it to long-on
Dhawan keeps it nice and straight and cramps him up for room, he defends
stays beside the line and works it towards backward point
gives himself room and he steers it to Balaji at third man
fullish and swinging in and he works it to midwicket
close call for Samson as he mistimes the loft towards long-on, it went off the toe of the bat, one bounce to the fielder
he makes room and punches it down to long-off
lunges forward and pushes it to the off side
this was really wide down the leg side, Binny was looking to smash it
no turn this time, makes room and punches it to cover
gives it more air and he gets forward and drives on the up towards long-off
down the track and he gets an inside edge to square leg
tossed up and he works it towards midwicket
fullish in length on the off stump and he drives to long-off
swings it back in and he clips it to the on side
he steers this one down to third man
the keeper goes back for the hat trick ball, Binny pushes it to the off side

Dhawan's rattled the furniture again and this time it's Watto! Like the previous ball he got the  ball to move back in through the air, Watson was looking to push it to the off side but left a small gap between pad and bat, the ball clipped the off stump, the keeper was up to the stumps
Dhawan's got the important wicket, he gets it to swing back in, Rahane was playing down the wrong line, left a gap between bat and pad and bowled through the gate
turn again and he chops it to point
good one from Karanveer as he forces Samson to check his shot, he was down the pitch and chose to defend on seeing the length
he gets a bit of turn and bowls it wide, he cuts
gets forward and pushes a single to cover
tossed up and he softly defends
good length outside off and he punches it towards deep point
carries over fine leg, this was a short ball rearing in on the helmet, he hooks and it's high in the air and has enough to clear the rope
slower ball outside off and he shoulders arms
he drops it short and he swivels and pulls him towards deep square leg
good running, he drops it towards short point and sets off quickly and his partner sets off
wide outside off and it's in the air towards third man
that's a low full toss on the pads, swinging back in  and he clips it away to deep midwicket
punched towards backward point and Samson set off and was sent back
cleverly played, the keeper was up and he wasn't afraid to play the late cut, the ball came back in and cramped him for room but he adjusted well, played to third man
on the pads and clipped off the pads to the leg side, Dhawan appeals but it was sliding down leg, they take a leg bye
good length on the pads and worked to square leg
that rocketed off the bat, Rahane gave Dhawan the charge early and chipped a full ball wide of mid-off, it was in the air and well clear of the fielder
tossed up and he drives it back to the bowler, good over
drifts back in and it's only a single to long-on
quicker and flatter and doesn't give him room, he punches it to point
keeps him quiet, he can only push this down to point
this one darted back in and he punched it towards cover
tossed up and he drives a full ball towards deep point
on the pads and clipped to square leg, Rahane hurries the single to beat Balaji's throw
Samson plays that late, opens the face and dabs it towards third man
on the pads and clipped away and Balaji misfields at square leg
he slides down the leg side and wide called
gives a little width and he looks to cut but mistimes it to cover point
gives him width and he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
good inswing by Dhawan straightaway, dipping in and Samson does well to cover the line
excellent stop by Akshar at fine leg, this was on the pads and Rahane flicked it away neatly and Akshar really had to time his dive right and that's what he did
lands outside off and he doesn't play at it

Bailey takes the skier, this was short of a length and Nair was down the track looking to deposit this somewhere, not near the pitch of it and it was a top edge that swirled towards cover, Bailey keeps his gaze on the ball
angles this slightly inwards and he gets forward and across and defends
this was short and wide outside off and asking to be hit, Nair got across and thrashed this over backward point
outside off and he opens the face and dabs it down to third man
short and widish, Karun latches on it eagerly, and hops to slap it powerfully in front of square
bouncer, slanted across at 133 kph, Karun sways inside the line
length ball turned past square leg again, it is a longer chase for Balaji this time but the ball slows down and he is able to save a run
tries to cut, but this short of a length delivery comes in and cramps him for room, he finds point
gets bat around the front pad to tuck this length delivery past square leg, Balaji runs across from fine leg and dives to keep it in, top effort
what a ripper first up from Hendricks, an inswinging yorker on the stumps, somehow Rahane gets front leg away from the line and jabs it behind square
softly taps at a straightening good length ball towards point and takes a single
Balaji past the outside edge second time in the over, goes wide of the crease, angles it in outside off and moves it away sharply, Rahane prods in vain
Balaji goes short and wide, Rahane tries to fetch it, and ends up dragging it just over mid on
holding the line from a good length again, pushed to point
beats him, Rahane goes pushing at a wide delivery that straightens and bounces past the outside edge
a low full toss angled in to off, Rahane leans across and works it to mid on
